subject: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rao <sam.rao@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procure@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion attached are the latest MSA + Order Form redlines that reflect the auto-renew notice window we proposed (60 days), the termination-for-convenience carveout language, and a short appendix that calls out delegated approval thresholds for order changes during the initial term.

Two things we want to confirm from your side:
- Whether Acme needs a longer notice window to align with your internal fiscal calendar (you mentioned Oct 1 renewal cadence).
- Who in Procurement will hold delegated approval authority for modifications under $75k (we proposed delegation to Procurement Manager in the Order Form).

Attachments: redlines_acme_olga_20260902.pdf (redline), signed_msa_markup.docx (markup with comments)

Proposed next steps: if Procurement confirms delegated approver and notice window, legal can finalize and we’ll issue a final Order Form for signature. If you prefer, we can have Laura run through the exact legal language on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Sam Rao <sam.rao@acme.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience

Olga —

Thanks for sending this over. A couple quick clarifications from Acme Procurement & Legal:
1) Notice window: 60 days is OK for our products group, but Finance will want a 90-day heads-up for any renewal that impacts year-end budgets. Can we make the Order Form language say "60 days, except where Customer's finance policy requires up to 90 days"?

2) Delegated approval: we like the idea of Procurement holding delegation, but we need to confirm the dollar threshold. Procurement prefers $100k rather than $75k.

3) Termination for convenience: our legal team flagged that we need a 60-day ramp for offboarding (data export and deprovisioning) if Acme terminates for convenience; can Redwood confirm SLAs for data handoff in that bucket?

I’ve looped in Acme Legal and Procurement — they’ll chime in on specifics. If needed, we can do a quick sync at 11:30 PT today.

—Sam
Sam Rao
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
sam.rao@acme.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rao <sam.rao@acme.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience

Sam / Olga —

Quick responses from Legal after reviewing the attached markups:

- Notice window language: we can incorporate a conditional clause that allows Customer-specific finance policies to override up to 90 days. Suggested wording in the redline: "Notwithstanding the foregoing, where Customer’s documented procurement or finance policy requires a longer notice, such longer period (up to 90 days) shall apply." Please confirm this satisfies Finance.

- Delegation threshold: Redwood is comfortable with delegation to an identified Procurement approver on Customer letterhead for modifications up to $100,000 per Order Form year. We will require a signed authorization letter (one-page) attached to the Order Form that lists the approver's name, title, and email.

- Termination-for-convenience offboarding: Redwood confirms a 60-day offboarding period for termination-for-convenience. During that period Redwood will provide: export of customer data in machine-readable format (S3-compatible export), support for deprovisioning APIs, and one weekly checkpoint call. SLA metrics (data availability and export integrity) are called out in Appendix B of the redline.

Attachment referenced: signed_msa_markup.docx — contains the proposed conditional language and the sample delegation letter template (see page 4).

If those points are acceptable, Legal can produce a final clean MSA + Order Form for signature by EOD Friday.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Deputy General Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rao <sam.rao@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. From GTM side, two practical asks:
1) Procurement authorization: once Acme confirms the approver and provides the one-page authorization, we can accept delegation up to $100k and proceed without exec sign-off. That keeps closing time short.
2) Offboarding ops: Laura — can you confirm that the S3 export will be complete within 7 business days of request and that support includes at least two support-engineer hours during the 60-day ramp? We'll flag that in the SOW.

Sam — if Procurement confirms the $100k threshold today, I’ll push the final clean to Acme and instruct Ops to prep the export playbook.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarify notice triggers & delegated approval for auto-renew / termination-for-convenience

Sam / team —

Appreciate the quick responses. Summary & next steps:
- Notice window: Redwood to include conditional clause allowing Customer finance policy up to 90 days. Laura will add the exact language in the final clean.
- Delegation: Acme to confirm the delegated approver and provide the one-page authorization. Procurement confirm $100k — pending your note, Sam.
- Offboarding: Redwood confirms 60-day ramp; Ops to deliver S3 export within 7 business days of request and provide two engineer hours for handoff during the 60-day ramp (see Appendix B).

Action items:
- Sam / Procurement: send the delegation letter (one-pager) and confirm $100k threshold (by EOD today if possible).
- Laura: produce final clean MSA + Order Form and upload to Drive (link below).
- Karthik / Ops: prepare export playbook and SOW appendix.

If we get the delegation letter today we can issue the final Order Form for signature tomorrow. I’ll schedule a 30-min wrap call for 10:30 PT Thu to walk through the final language (calendar invite to follow).
